observations: Photo 0 shows a large, black, V8-style engine with a ribbed intake manifold and various components attached. The engine is placed on a paved surface, with a concrete curb and part of a vehicle frame visible on the right.
Photo 1 shows the front of the engine, revealing the timing belt, pulleys, and various hoses and belts. The engine appears to be a V8, with a visible intake manifold and throttle body.
Photo 2 shows a side view of the engine, with the cylinder head and intake manifold visible. The engine is secured with straps, and there is visible wear and grime on the components.
The watermark 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is present on all photos, suggesting the seller is a dealer or reseller of Porsche parts.
No visible branding or model identifiers are readable on the engine block or components in any photo.
The engine appears to be a used, non-running unit, with no signs of recent operation or maintenance.

risks.risk: The engine may be damaged or non-functional, with internal wear or missing components.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running or a close-up of the cylinder head, crankshaft, and internal components.

risks.risk: The engine may not be from a Porsche, as the watermark suggests a dealer specializing in Porsche parts, but no model or VIN is visible.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block with visible casting numbers or a VIN tag.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic V8 engine, not Porsche-specific

risks.risk: The engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle, affecting its value and usability.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine's serial number and any damage indicators.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown condition, with lower value

proof_requests: A clear photo of the engine block showing casting numbers or VIN tag.
A video of the engine running or a close-up of the internal components.
A photo of the vehicle from which the engine was salvaged, if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
